name: @verikit/react
description: React UI bindings for Verikit resource workflows.
author: Chidi E <hi@ceeso.dev>

scripts.test: rm -rf .test-dist && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test $(find ./.test-dist/test -name '*.test.js' -type f | sort)
scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf .test-dist coverage && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='.test-dist/src/**/*.js' $(find ./.test-dist/test -name '*.test.js' -type f | sort)
